definitions.full: H2325. chub [ חוּב ] verb be guilty (Late Hebrew id., be under obligation, guilty ; Aramaic , חוּב , be defeated, guilty ; Arabic be disappointed, fail ; — Arabic , sin , is loan-word according to Bev Dan 1:10 ); — Qal not in MT; but read perhaps חַבְתִּי (for סַבֹּתִי ) 1Sam 22:22 I am guilty , so ᵑ6 Th We Dr. Pi`el Perfect inculpate לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ אתרֿאֹשִׁי וְחִיַּבְתֶּם consecutive Dan 1:10 and inculpate my head with the king .
